```php
namespace Database\Seeders;

use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;

class UrlSeeder extends Seeder
{
    /**
     * Run the database seeds.
     *
     * @return void
     */
    public function run()
    {
        for ($i = 0; $i < 10; $i++) {
            $fake = \Faker\Factory::create();
            $url = $fake->url();
            \App\Models\Url::create(['url' => $url]);
        }
    }
}
```
